major_cooldowns.name: Takedown
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown as your primary burst window, always buffed with a Tip of the Spear stack and synced with Bloodlust, on-use trinkets, and your potion.

major_cooldowns.name: Boomstick
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Spend a Tip of the Spear stack on this high-damage frontal cone whenever it is available, holding it for stacked packs in AoE since Lethal Calibration drops its cooldown as low as 15 seconds.

major_cooldowns.name: Wildfire Bomb
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Pre-cast roughly one GCD before the pull and then keep both charges rolling, spending a Tip of the Spear stack on each and never letting it sit fully recharged.

major_cooldowns.name: Flamefang Pitch
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use during Takedown so it lines up naturally with Savagery, but avoid casting it if you cannot hold another Wildfire Bomb charge.

major_cooldowns.name: Moonlight Chakram
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: On the Sentinel build this replaces Takedown on the same keybind; spend a Tip of the Spear stack on it on cooldown, delaying with Stalk and Strike to capture the 10s Wildfire Bomb cooldown reduction.

rules.description: Open Wildfire Bomb then Takedown burst
rules.action: Pre-cast Hunter's Mark and a Wildfire Bomb about one GCD before the pull, then open with Takedown plus Harpoon, follow with Wildfire Bomb, Boomstick, and Kill Command to start fueling Tip of the Spear, and sync your potion and on-use trinkets into this window.

rules.description: Spend Tip of the Spear on every empowered cast
rules.action: Keep generating Tip of the Spear with Kill Command and spend a stack on Wildfire Bomb, Boomstick, Takedown, and Raptor Swipe so Strike as One procs as often as possible; never let stacks overcap and never spend Kill Command when you are already capped.

rules.description: Use Kill Command without overcapping resources
rules.action: Press Kill Command as often as charges allow to feed Focus and Tip of the Spear, but stop short of overcapping either resource; with the optimal build you should fit two other abilities between each Kill Command.

rules.description: Buff Takedown with Tip of the Spear
rules.action: Always enter Takedown with a Tip of the Spear stack ready to spend on it (or at zero stacks when talented into Twin Fangs) so its short window captures the 20% class-ability damage buff.

rules.description: Hold Boomstick for stacked AoE packs
rules.action: In AoE, hold Boomstick until mobs are stacked rather than dumping it on single target, since it only costs about a 2.5% single-target loss but gains far more value lined up with Lethal Calibration cooldown reduction across a pull.

rules.description: Aim Boomstick and Wildfire Bomb cones
rules.action: Position so the Boomstick cone (from you) and Wildfire Bomb cone (from the target) cover as many enemies as possible; a quick Disengage can set ideal Boomstick range, and angle Stampede and Raptor Swipe to catch the pack.

rules.description: Pool bombs and Boomstick until adds stack
rules.action: When adds are inbound, cycle Kill Command, Raptor Strike, and Raptor Swipe to pool, then unload Boomstick, Wildfire Bomb, and Takedown once the pack is settled so Stampede and the cones hit the full group.

rules.description: Keep Hunter's Mark on the priority target
rules.action: Apply Hunter's Mark before combat and re-apply it whenever it falls off or the priority target swaps; it does not pull and refreshing it costs almost nothing.
